summary: Ardagh Metal Packaging S.A. filed a Form 6-K with an attached press release announcing a quarterly interim dividend of $0.10 per ordinary share, payable on September 24, 2026 to shareholders of record on September 10, 2026. This is a routine declaration of a regular quarterly cash dividend, not a special situation event. No merger, acquisition, tender offer, activist campaign, restructuring, or other special-situation transaction is disclosed. The filing is a standard periodic report of a foreign private issuer and is incorporated by reference into a previously filed registration statement.
